question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: On the Aug 26, 2026 Q2 FY27 call, CFO Kress said gross margins would bottom in Q4 at 71-72% before recovering to 72-73% in FY28 as price increases take effect in Q1. NVIDIA typically guides a single figure +/-50bp, and GAAP equals non-GAAP in recent guides, so 71.5% is the natural midpoint. Past forward hints (e.g. 'exit year mid-70s') were matched by formal guides. TrendForce shows DRAM/HBM prices still rising (~20% QoQ in Q4) but decelerating, consistent with the prior framing. Risks: a conservative 71.0 guide, or an upside 72.0+ from mix/pricing. No market prices the Q4 guide; Polymarket only covers Q3 actual non-GAAP GM (73-75% bucket at 0.76, thin volume), which is a different quantity used as evidence only.
calls.dossier:
- NVIDIA Q2 FY27 press release (Aug 26, 2026): revenue $96.2B; GAAP & non-GAAP GM 75.0%; Q3 FY27 outlook GAAP & non-GAAP GM 74.0% +/-50bp; revenue $108.0B +/-2%.
- Q2 FY27 earnings call (Aug 26, 2026; via BigGo Finance, GamesReviews): Kress: 'We expect margins to bottom in Q4 in the 71% to 72% range before settling at 72% to 73% in fiscal year 2028 as executed price increases take effect in Q1.' Also: memory price increase magnitude 'exceeded our prior expectations and are headed even higher into next year.'
- Earlier FY27 framing (FY26 calls): goal to hold GM 'in the mid-70s' for FY27, later revised down due to memory.
- Recent guides set GAAP = non-GAAP GM (Q3 FY27 guide both 74.0%).
- NVIDIA guide format: single figure +/-50bp (midpoint = figure); historically uses .0 or .5 steps (e.g., 70.5, 71.0, 73.0, 74.0, 75.0).
- TrendForce Sep 30, 2026: conventional DRAM contract prices +10-15% QoQ in 4Q26; Oct 20, 2026 note: blended incl. HBM ~+20% QoQ, slowing from ~80% (2Q) and ~40% (3Q); LTA price ceilings taking effect.
- HBM contract prices reported possibly to multiply by 2027 (BigGo), a cost headwind into FY28.
- Precedent: Kress's 'exit year mid-70s' hint for FY26 was followed by a Q4 FY26 guide of ~75.0%; the 'low 70s' Blackwell-ramp hint was followed by guides in the low 70s.
- Status quo: the formal guide matches the 71-72% verbal hint given last quarter.
- Markets: none found on the Q4 GM guide; Polymarket markets exist only on Q3 actual non-GAAP GM.
- Resolves off the Outlook section of the Q3 FY27 press release (expected Nov 17, 2026), GAAP GM midpoint rounded to 0.1pp, not Q3 actual GM or call commentary.
- Event window: single release on Nov 17, 2026; as of Oct 31, 2026 the window has not opened.
- Searched without finding: any September/October 2026 management update to Q4 GM commentary; consensus sell-side Q4 GM estimates.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: the 71-72% Q4 bottom pre-signal, the 74.0% Q3 guide, GAAP=non-GAAP, and the +/-50bp format. There was no factual dispute to settle, and I had no web access. The only disagreement is judgment on the upside tail (Run 2 was wider toward 72.5-73). I land near Runs 1 and 3 with a slightly fatter tail at 72.0 and above, because NVIDIA sometimes lands at the top of a pre-signal when price increases come through. Dispersion follows Run 1/3's ~1.2, widened a little. No market matches the contract: Polymarket buckets are on Q3 actual non-GAAP GM, a different quantity.

disagreements.claim: Upside tail: how likely is a guide of 72.5% or higher
disagreements.verdict: Memory costs are still rising and management just cut its outlook, so I give about 8% to 72.5+, closer to Runs 1 and 3 than Run 2
